name: Fan-Out 250K (10 min)
comments: 5 publishers, 5 topics, 1000 subscribers each subscribed to all 5 topics.
Publish rate 50/s per publisher = 250/s in, delivered as 250/s x 1000 = 250k/s out.
The inbound side is trivial; what this measures is delivery fan-out - one received
Twice the 5-minute variant, and for one reason: over five minutes the delivery latency
climbs steadily from ~2.1ms to ~5ms while the rate holds at 250k/s. Five minutes cannot
say whether that settles at some ceiling or goes on rising, and the difference matters -
the first is a broker running warm, the second is a queue that never drains.
Connections are paced at 5000/s. A thousand clients are no burst, so this changes nothing
here - it is declared so that every scenario states its ramp rather than leaving the
reader to work out which ones have one.
